'''AD-304''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. AD-304 delivered messages for officers such as [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jadick]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
